To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the performance of learning systems can be improved by: 1) increasing the number of training samples; 2) increasing the number and/or decreasing the size of the classes; and 3) increasing the degree of overlapping between the classes.

(i) class overlapping is the main problem in imbalanced domains; (ii) class imbalances are a problem only when class overlapping exists; and (iii) class overlapping is a problem for all learning algorithms, but it is a problem for some more than others.

(1) the performance of learning systems is more affected by class overlapping than by class imbalance; and (2) the performance of a learning algorithm is more affected by the degree of overlapping between classes than by the number of classes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new problem that is related to the class imbalance problem.
the question: is class imbalance a real problem or is it a symptom of a more general problem?
the following question: Is class overlapping a problem by itself?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
both class imbalances and overlapping among the classes affect negatively the performance of learning algorithms and that both are important issues to be addressed.
the problem is caused by a class overlapping problem, which is a consequence of the class imbalances.
the loss of performance is caused by the combination of the degree of class overlapping and the class imbalances.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
class imbalances are a problem when the classes overlap too much.
the problem is more related to the overlapping among the classes, than the imbalance between them.
class imbalances can be a problem when there is a high degree of overlapping between classes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the problem is caused by the overlap between classes, and not by class imbalances.
class imbalances should not be considered as the only problem when dealing with learning systems performance.
class imbalances are a problem when they are coupled to class overlapping.
